name: Bitbucket
description: Bitbucket is Atlassian's Git code hosting and CI/CD product, described on its site as "Code & CI/CD, powered by AI and the Atlassian platform," built around native Jira integration.
best_for: Teams already using Jira who want commit messages/issue keys to automatically update Jira status and reduce context-switching between planning and code.
features: Native Jira issue-status integration via commit messages
AI-powered code review, search, and chat
Pull request review with third-party report integration

alternatives.name: GitHub
alternatives.description: The widely-adopted developer platform combining repos, Actions CI/CD, and Copilot AI tooling.
alternatives.best_for: Individual developers through large enterprises across many industries.

alternatives.name: GitLab
alternatives.description: A single-application DevSecOps platform spanning planning, CI/CD, and security scanning.
alternatives.best_for: Organizations wanting to consolidate multiple DevOps tools into one platform.
